verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client, so sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times into an email is a fair question for this kind of product, and the axis applies. The evidence covers email compose and drafts, labels, search, AI assistance, MCP, and self-hosting. None of it mentions calendar integration, availability sharing, or scheduling links.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
